nextHour.rootCause: Snow/sleet summary symbols were rejected by the prior conversion allowlist even though the pinned upstream WK3 declarations and provider support these symbols. The actual Tangshan snow request is not available as a replay fixture; the provided diagnostic proves the source value snow and valid wet/probability/time arrays, while the exact downstream rejection was from missing supported phase enums.
nextHour.conversion: SNOW and SLEET summaries map only to their upstream-declared WK3 precipitation enums with strictly aligned positive minute evidence. SNOW/HEAVY_SNOW and SLEET/POSSIBLE_SLEET conditions are phase-bound to matching validated summaries. FLURRIES/POSSIBLE_FLURRIES have no guessed enum; only their whole descriptive vector may be omitted when a validated SNOW summary and minute evidence exist. Hail, mixed phase, unknown symbols, contradictions, incomplete values or bad timing fail open.
nextHour.diagnosticHeader: X-WK3-NextHour-Diag WK3NH/4; bounded stage, symbol, phase, wet/probability flags, summary/condition/minute counts, interval size, timeline result and coarse pattern; excludes coordinates, tokens and response body.
